pages.text: Compared to the bloody products recorded in ancient texts, you used magic to create a more modular and elegant machine.$(br)This machine will become the starting point of your calamity army.$(br)Input any food that restores hunger to convert it into $(l:goetymech_crafts/twisted_embryo)Twisted Embryos$(/l).$(br)$(4)"Sometimes I have to admit, these Illagers are far more talented in cruelty than I am, even when facing their own kind."$()
